Message-ID: <2026-08-20-bluepeak-incident-notice@mail.northwindpay.example>
From: Clara Jensen <clara@northwindpay.example>
To: Marco Ortiz <marco@bluepeak.example>
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 15:40:00 +0000
Subject: Incident notifications going forward
Content-Type: text/plain; charset=utf-8

Hi Marco,

After the August timeouts I want to be clear about what you can expect. We will notify Bluepeak within 15 minutes of any incident that affects the Payments API.

Clara
